A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CR-Net study and provide readable text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–G. v3 removes the contents pages but retains the substantive appendix material, supporting a reliable comparison.

before.justification: Section 5 and Appendices E and G report original CR-Net pre-training, fine-tuning, ablation, throughput, and multi-GPU measurements, alongside results attributed to prior work.

after.justification: v3 retains the original CR-Net experiments and measurements, including the main performance tables, appendix fine-tuning results, and empirical pipeline-parallel verification in Appendix G.

M1.justification: Sections 3.2–3.3 and Algorithm 1 retain the same full-rank first layer, low-rank cross-layer residuals with learnable scaling, and activation-recomputation procedure. The MoE adaptation in Appendix E.3 is also unchanged.

E1.justification: Both retain C4-en pre-training, TinyShakespeare activation studies, Wikitext-2 and arXiv-abstract fine-tuning, and the longer-sequence scenario in Appendix E.2.7. No dataset, task, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the main tables, Figure 6's Learnable-ResFormer and DenseFormer comparison, and appendix experiments. The added MoE-related citation in Appendix A does not participate in an evaluated comparison.

E3.justification: Reported settings remain unchanged, including the 256-token C4 setup, 2048-token longer-sequence evaluation, Table 10 rank assignments, training budgets, evaluation metrics, and throughput and pipeline configurations. Relocated passages do not introduce protocol revisions.

E4.justification: The rank-allocation, fixed versus learned scaling, alternative-residual, first-layer, and activation-quantization ablations are retained. Layerwise reconstruction errors, scaling-factor distributions, and pipeline communication analyses also remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental seed counts, repeated-run uncertainty estimates, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The tables and plots retain the same statistical reporting practices.

E6.justification: Matched numerical entries and plotted findings are unchanged. For example, Table 3 retains CR-Net perplexities of 15.22 and 14.05 for its two 1B configurations, Table 4 retains 13.72 at 80K steps, and Appendix G retains the 1.380-second communication measurement.

T1.justification: Appendices B–D retain the same propagation and complexity derivations, cosine-similarity assumption, stable-rank definition, Theorem 1, and proof. v3 numbers previously unnumbered equations and updates references without changing the mathematics.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about low-rank activation differences, CR-Net's architecture, recomputation savings, and empirical advantages. Neither the claimed novelty nor contribution scope changes.

C2.justification: The stated stability mechanism, interpretations of scaling and first-layer ablations, and computation–communication tradeoffs remain unchanged. Section 6 retains the same future directions concerning mixed precision and alternative attention architectures.

D1.justification: v3 adds a first-page project link to the KongBoao/CR-Net GitHub repository, absent from v2. Hyperparameters, hardware, quantization instructions, and pipeline implementation details remain unchanged. The PDFs establish the added access pointer; repository contents cannot be assessed from them.

R1.justification: Appendix A adds Hu et al. (2026), reference 28, on intra- and cross-layer regularization for MoE expert specialization, with one explanatory sentence. The other cited works and CR-Net's central research positioning are retained.

P1.justification: v3 removes v2's two-page contents list, consolidates author and contact information, and makes limited wording, grammar, and caption edits. The main sections and Appendices A–G retain their order and almost all their prose.

P2.justification: v3 redesigns the document with green MELON headers, sans-serif typography, a shaded title and abstract panel, and revised heading and caption styles. Figure and table placement changes throughout, and equation numbering expands. All nine scientific figures and 22 tables retain their substantive content.

improvement.justification: The added project link and MoE reference modestly improve access guidance and research context. Expanded equation numbering helps referencing, although removing the contents list creates a navigation tradeoff. These gains are limited because the method, mathematical argument, and empirical support remain unchanged.
